summary: The marketing team is juggling multiple high-priority initiatives, with the China Going-Global report and Tech in Asia sponsorship demanding immediate attention, while SEO and website redesign efforts progress in parallel.
summaryDetail: The most pressing matter is the China Going-Global report, with Joseph reviewing the compiled draft and providing notes by August 5th, while the team also finalizes the Tech in Asia sponsorship details, including the event brief and official confirmation, ahead of the September conference. Concurrently, the SEO strategy is being refined, prioritizing Asia Star and Intelligent China programs, with Joseph drafting target areas and the team analyzing participant data to boost search visibility. The knowledge website redesign is moving forward, with the team incorporating elements from Joseph's alternative design and providing specific feedback, while also addressing the Outlook account lockout issue that is disrupting internal communications. Upcoming, the team will expedite the social media agency selection, with Media Minds as the likely choice, and finalize decisions on the Caixin Singapore summit cooperation and the Nov Forum engagement.
